headline: Red readiness day — sleep debt and a load spike from a stacked week; today's Un1t should be eased or skipped.
body_state: Deterministic verdict is red: readiness 39.3/100 (low band, driver sleep), acute:chronic load ratio 1.57 (>1.5 carries 2–4× injury risk next week) on top of 26h of 14-day sleep debt after 5.4h last night. Deep sleep was just 11% (2,220s, target 13–23%) with zero REM. Body battery recharged only +31 overnight and sits at 33 now — under the 40 threshold quality work needs. Resting HR is up to 53 vs your 49.6 baseline. TSB -20.63 is technically the productive training zone, but overtraining status reads "caution" on top of it.
session: No running session today — the plan's next workout is tomorrow's 7km easy run. The calendar has Un1t (45min cardio) booked. Your last three Un1t sessions ran 61% zone-3, RPE 6-8 — moderate-hard, not the recovery this body needs today. Given the red verdict's explicit call ("if today has intensity, swap it with your next easy day"), either skip it and let tomorrow's easy run be the week's next stimulus, or take it genuinely easy: cap effort so HR stays mostly under ~130-135, not the usual zone-3 grind.
recent: Yesterday's tempo (8/12) underdelivered: only 2.98 of the planned 4km at threshold pace, and slower than target (4:38/km vs 4:18-4:32/km) — HR averaged just 143, never reaching your 163 threshold, despite an RPE 8 rating. Monday (8/11) stacked a zone-3-dominant Un1t (61% Z3) with a 2h road ride the same evening — good ride pacing (136W, HR 106, mostly Z1-2) but two stimuli in one day. Sunday (8/10) the "easy" run ran 89.7% in zone 3 with a negative split — not actually easy. The grey-zone pattern (fitness.json's #2 limiter) keeps recurring: sessions billed easy or moderate keep landing hard, and real recovery days are scarce.
focus: Protect today: skip or genuinely ease Un1t — readiness is red and load is already spiked (ACWR 1.57).
When a session says 'easy,' keep HR under ~135 — three sessions running in zone 3 is the direct cause of the grey-zone limiter.
Get to bed ~60min earlier tonight — deep sleep is at 11% and sleep debt is now 26h over 14 days.
